verse_text_english: We threw him out into the desert, exhausted.
We grew for him an edible tree.
Then we sent him to a hundred thousand people, or more.
verse_text_arabic: وَأَرْسَلْنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِا۟ئَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-arsalnāhu ilā mi-ati alfin aw yazīdūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وأرسلنه إلى مائة ألف أو يزيدون

verse_text_english: They believed, and we let them enjoy their lives.
Consult them; does your Lord have daughters, while they have sons?
Did we create the angels as females? Did they witness? 151.
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِنَٰثًا وَهُمْ شَٰهِدُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: am khalaqnā l-malāikata ināthan wahum shāhidūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم خلقنا الملئكة إنثا وهم شهدون

verse_text_english: Indeed, they grossly blaspheme when they say—
“God has begotten a son!” They are liars.
Did He prefer daughters over sons?
What is wrong with you? How do you make those statements?
Would you not take heed?
Do you have any proof?
Show me your scripture, if you are truthful. 158.
They even invented a special relationship between Him and the jinns. The jinns themselves know that they are subservient.
verse_text_arabic: وَجَعَلُوا۟ بَيْنَهُۥ وَبَيْنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ نَسَبًا وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ ٱلْجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wajaʿalū baynahu wabayna l-jinati nasaban walaqad ʿalimati l-jinatu innahum lamuḥ'ḍarūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وجعلوا بينه وبين الجنة نسبا ولقد علمت الجنة إنهم لمحضرون

verse_text_english: God be glorified; high above their claims.
Only the devoted servants of God are saved.
You and the idols you worship.
Do not bother Him in the least.
It is the idol worshipers who will burn in hell. (J64^ Each one of us (angels) has a recognized position.
Each one of us has a specific job.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا مِنَّآ إِلَّا لَهُۥ مَقَامٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā minnā illā lahu maqāmun maʿlūmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما منا إلا له مقام معلوم

verse_text_english: It is we who will arrange them in ranks.
It is we who glorify Him. 167.
They used to say,
“If we receive a message, like those before us,
verse_text_arabic: لَوْ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكْرًا مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: law anna ʿindanā dhik'ran mina l-awalīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: لو أن عندنا ذكرا من الأولين

verse_text_english: “We would be devoted servants of God.”
They disbelieved therein, and consequently, they will find out.
Our decree has already been issued to our servant messengers.
They will always be victorious.
Our soldiers will always be winners.
Therefore, disregard them for awhile.
Watch them, and they will be watching.
Are they in a hurry to see our retribution? 177.
When it hits them one day, it will be a miserable day; they have been sufficiently warned.
verse_text_arabic: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-idhā nazala bisāḥatihim fasāa ṣabāḥu l-mundharīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فإذا نزل بساحتهم فساء صباح المنذرين

verse_text_english: Just leave them alone for awhile.
Watch them, and they will be watching. 180.
Glory be to your Lord, the great Lord; far above their claims.
verse_text_arabic: سُبْحَٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: sub'ḥāna rabbika rabbi l-ʿizati ʿammā yaṣifūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: سبحن ربك رب العزة عما يصفون

verse_text_english: And peace be upon the messengers.
Praise be to God, Lord of the universe.
